state.rule: One calendar stream per program. Active Type II ranges of the program never overlap. The aggregate appends only the exact prepared decision at the current native sequence; the selected logical id selects one acceptance and never forks the stream.

code_behavior.retry_test: After one authorization is appended, the same prepared decision is appended again at the now-current native sequence. The aggregate refuses with a non-transient conflict because the prepared before-cut no longer matches the calendar header; pending events stay at 1 and revision stays 1.
code_behavior.tamper_test: A prepared decision whose authority content hash was altered is refused with a conflict and no fact is appended.
code_behavior.catalog: Code events TypeIIPeriodRangeAuthorized and TypeIIPeriodRangeSettled match the approved catalog; no event added, removed or renamed.

retry_asserts.instructions: The test in state.code_behavior.retry_test proves a duplicate append of an already committed range authorization adds no second fact.

criteria.true: The duplicate is refused and exactly one fact remains.
criteria.false: The scenario could pass while a second duplicate fact is appended.

tamper_asserts.instructions: The test in state.code_behavior.tamper_test proves a prepared decision that does not match its fact appends nothing.

criteria.true: The altered preparation is refused and no fact is appended.
criteria.false: The scenario could pass while a fact is appended.

catalog_gap.instructions: Given state.code_behavior.catalog, is there any discrepancy between code events and the approved catalog needing action?

criteria.no_discrepancy: Code and catalog agree; nothing to change.
criteria.add_to_model: Code has an owner-decision event the catalog lacks.
criteria.remove: Code has an event the catalog does not want.
